title: Menu Sham Di Paishi Maar Gae
body:
Menu Sham di paishi maar gae Menu Sham di paishi maar
gae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Menu her koi puchda aay Sughra das Abid teray jeundeya kyun dhee Zahra darbar gae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Main waris puo di pag da saa’n us pag da main ki haal dassa’n
Onay jhaliyan san tera zarbaa’n babay day khoon ich dubbi oh meray sir tay aa dastar gae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jehri yad Madina kerdi si mu ker kay Madinay day pasay
Barri der taen chup oh rehndi zindan utto ud’di ud’di jado panchiyan di koi daar gae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Main ratt kyun rona ki aakhaa’n ek manzar akhiyan nahin bhuliyan
Jiday naaz uthaye babay nay oh bhain Sakina dunya toun lay kay neelay rukhsar gae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Saah rukda si kadi chalda si zakhmi sir cho lahu wagda si
Jinj barchi sham day zalim di Akbar day jigar cho paar gae enj maa bazar toun paar gae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Akbar Sajjad aay vayn karay saah ek din ruknay nay lekin
Enj rooh niklay gi Abid di jinj sardeya khaimeya cho Sughra
Meri maa bin chadar bahar gae..
